paragraphs: R' Yaakov, son of Shmuel’s daughter.
Mentioned in [Berakhot 25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.25b.23); Bali transmitted a ruling in his name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Bali transmitting in the name of Rav Yaakov, son of Shmuel’s daughter. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2106&lang=en) cites that same transmission.
Hyman’s notice abbreviates Yaakov’s title. The linked Gemara writes Rav in full. Both give the relationship through Shmuel’s daughter.
